# Research review fixture

`weekly-review-2026-10-23.md` is the actual weekly review supplied by the user in this project conversation. It is retained verbatim as secondary, unverified input for SCI-001. Its scientific assertions, numerical results, links and assessments are not endorsed by the fixture or the importer. Tests do not fetch referenced publications.

Unit tests parse the original. The database demonstration imports the original under a local test membership in a rollback-only transaction. HTTP tests use a clearly synthetic short report with a unique arXiv-shaped identifier to avoid modifying the user's existing records.
